summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the supplied RSA public key and enforced public-key-only SSH authentication. Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts were preserved. A full node reboot confirmed persistent configuration and service recovery.
actions_performed: Created opsadmin with a locked password.
Installed the supplied public key with secure ownership and permissions.
Disabled password and keyboard-interactive SSH authentication and required publickey.
Rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed sshd, account, authorized key, and key-only policy recovered after reboot.

evidence.requirement: opsadmin account and supplied public key
evidence.summary: Shows the account, locked password, secure key-file permissions, and RSA fingerprint SHA256:SOtEda/YMy4/DAn3ColZo2z+LOEd2WbOIPn4KqW5/dc before and after reboot.

Shows successful sshd validation/reload and effective settings: public-key enabled, password and keyboard-interactive disabled, and AuthenticationMethods publickey. Live negotiation offers only publickey.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed OS release and kernel

evidence.summary: Captures healthy baseline boot ID cda23648-fa86-42ea-b606-bcf03807d3b2, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 24c9af20-07ab-491e-b832-286868948594, and recovered sshd listener, account, key, configuration, and authentication policy.
